lf-diagram.description: A Mermaid diagram with optional comment targets on its named boxes.
lf-diagram.x-instructions: Write Mermaid source inside the pre, HTML-escaping & before < and >. Draw a chain of more than three steps top-down (flowchart TD), since a long horizontal chain scrolls past the page edge. Use classic flowchart node shapes. Unstyled nodes already use Leaf's accent surface; apply classDef only where a node needs a distinct tone, with fill, stroke, and color together, for example fill:var(--ok-tint),stroke:var(--ok),color:var(--ok-ink). Only those properties and stroke-width are honored. Quote labels containing their shape's closing bracket, as in A["names: list[str]"]. Agentic Mermaid ignores click/link targets, frontmatter, and sequence title; omit state-ending semicolons, declare a state's label before a transition names it, use symbolic ER relationships (||--o{), and write literal characters rather than entity codes such as #36;. These differences are not all caught by page check --render. Omit parts for one whole-diagram comment target. Otherwise list every box with a nameable source id as node:SOURCE_ID: flowchart nodes/subgraphs, states/composite states, sequence participants, classes, and ER entities. Edges, sequence messages, and chart marks have no stable source id.
lf-diagram.x-example:
flowchart TD
  Cart([Cart]) --> Pay{Paid?}
  Pay --> Receipt[(Receipt)]
  classDef done fill:var(--ok-tint),stroke:var(--ok),color:var(--ok-ink)
  class Receipt done
